sources.registry_source: net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks, static inspection of official class files; CFR 0.152 for source review

criteria.full_cube: Complete 16x16x16 outline and a complete opaque painted surface throughout its block states. Collision may differ from the outline.
criteria.block_entities: Excluded when the registered class or its superclass implements EntityBlock.
criteria.duplicates: One block representative per unique set of face textures, decoded RGBA pixels, animation metadata and tint-index usage; waxed and infested equivalents use the ordinary block.
criteria.states: One entry per block ID, not per orientation, powered state, age, snowy state or random model. All source model alternatives are recorded.
criteria.order: Block IDs in lexicographic order for this frozen 26.2 catalog.
criteria.not_included: Glass, leaves, copper grates, mangrove roots, transparent ice, honey/slime surfaces, air, fluids, invisible technical blocks, partial shapes, slabs (including double states), stairs, extended pistons and blocks with block entities.
criteria.surface_coverage: Exclude all glass and surfaces with holes, cutouts or partial alpha. A transparent overlay is permitted only above an opaque full-face base, as on grass blocks.

notes.cactus_excluded: CactusBlock has a 14-pixel-wide outline despite top and bottom faces using a 16-pixel model element.
notes.future_rendering: Only complete opaque surfaces remain. Tints, opaque layered compositions and animation require future rendering support. Native source states are reference material, not functional behavior to inherit.
notes.save_compatibility: PaintingMod keeps its current ID 16 for DEFAULT and reserved IDs 1..15 until a later explicitly authorized conversion.
notes.surface_review: Static RGBA inspection of every source texture and animation frame. Grass side overlay is retained because its source model supplies a complete opaque side beneath it. Transparent and cutout materials are excluded even when their selection outline is a cube.
